body.voice_description: Create an original cartoon chess-coach voice. Character: Proud dragon strategist; high standards, earned respect, discipline and contained power. Never cruel. Voice direction: Very low male bass with a controlled rough harmonic texture and precise British English. Restrained formidable authority and careful emphases. A believable speaking dragon, with no roaring or unintelligible distortion. Fluent spoken English, with the requested accent. Normal conversational pace with clear teaching emphasis; aim for an eight-to-ten-second passage without long dramatic pauses. Clean, dry studio recording, one intelligible voice, no music, background noise or animal sounds. Finish the final word completely with a natural settled ending. An original character voice, not an imitation of a named person or existing character.
body.text: A strong attack still needs discipline. This move leaves a piece unguarded, and the reply takes it. Keep control of what you already hold.
